reviews.author: Michael Ayers
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the work done on my 2015 Acura RDX. I was preparing to gift to my grandson and what a through and complete job that was done. Replaced axile, bearings, control arm all with expert craftsmanship and superb customer service. I would recommend this garage to anyone looking for a fair price and excellent work. Mike Ayers

reviews.author: Kelli Castellucci
reviews.text: I called a couple of places to get an alignment. Asher was the sweetest from the phone call to the service! He got my car in tip top shape and was super honest and reliable. I highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Sosa Dubon
reviews.text: I bought the car to AA auto repair. They replace my phone brakes. Brakes did complete tuneup and they sent me so much money from the other repair shop. What estimate was more higher highly recommend not expensive at all. Good service professional thank you to Asher from AA auto repair.

reviews.author: Hazaifa Liaquit
reviews.text: Great shop to get your brakes done. Asher is a very through guy. I would be back to work with him on the other parts of my car. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: I wanted to have my brakes checked. Called to come in to have them looked at. Got to come in same day. Brakes were replaced and calibration was done. Waited in lobby for under an hour. Great Military discounts.

reviews.author: Tina Peloro
reviews.text: Ascher at AA Repair provided excellent service! I was having difficulty with the brake system of an older car (225,000 miles) and wasn’t sure it was worth fixing. Ascher evaluated the job and assured me he could fix it at a reasonable cost. Ascher came through and did an EXCELLENT job! He is extremely knowledgeable about cars. I highly recommend him without reservation for all your auto repair needs!

reviews.author: AHMED IBRAHIM
reviews.text: Asher is hands down one of the best mechanics I got the pleasure of dealing with. A person with integrity and class, treats his customers/clients like family. I had an issue with my car and he did a diagnostic on my car free of charge insisting on not taking any money and gave me a detailed explanation on the problem and how it’s going to be fixed. He’s always smiling and very warm in his reception and communication. His expertise is unmatched and I couldn’t be happier with his service!

reviews.author: Joshua Hsieh
reviews.text: Ash did an outstanding job repairing my 2019 Hyundai Kona. He was able to fix my brake calipers instead of replacing them, which saved me a significant amount of money and the hassle of buying new parts. Had my brake pads replaced and brake flushed as well. His expertise, honesty, and attention to detail really stood out.

reviews.author: Firedragon_cK
reviews.text: Asher was amazing, he helped me out with front end work on my 2010 Toyota Highlander. He was truly amazing. He explained to me what he was doing throughout each step of the process. Other mechanics simply told me that fixing the vehicle was too much or not possible. Once I described my issue to Asher, he told me to bring it into the shop and he dealt with it right away. A true professional who takes his work very seriously, he does not play. Exceptional mechanic.

reviews.author: Frederick Lardaro
reviews.text: Excellent, thoughtful, skillful service. Provided for towing. A one stop shop where all the team is very customer focused. Affordable and I am delighted with the outcome and recommend A A Auto Repair and Towing.

reviews.author: J Santora
reviews.text: I had front-end work done on my 2018 BMW 540I, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The pricing was very reasonable, and Ashar was exceptionally professional and courteous throughout the entire process. The quality of the work was outstanding. I highly recommend Ashar for anyone needing reliable, top-notch service!

reviews.author: Briana Joyner
reviews.text: I recently brought my 2009 Subaru Tribeca in for repairs, and I’m extremely pleased with the service I received. The mechanic was excellent, he really took the time to listen to all of my concerns and addressed each issue one by one. It’s clear he cares about doing the job right, and the results definitely showed. My car is running great, and the whole experience left me very satisfied. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Laurie Vera
reviews.text: As you know we are all skeptical finding someone honest in this field . I went there for the first time trying to get my car fixed and to my surprise the owner Ash did. It charge me but was amazingly honest. Ash had taken the part apart to see if he could fix. Even though I felt the difference he said he would need to buy a part and a few days to fully fix the issue. With that said he didn’t even charge me . Wow now that’s honesty ! Thank you Ash for you amazing service . I will definitely be back !!

reviews.author: Alyssa E
reviews.text: Had an issue with an electrical short of my brake lights and Asher found issues with my front brakes and belt. He replaced everything in less than a day for a reasonable price. very good work!

reviews.author: Chrissie Andreini
reviews.text: I brought my car to AA Auto Repair because I had a nail in my tire and was losing a lot of air. The service was excellent! They were able to fit me in and get it repaired quickly. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nelle Rose
reviews.text: I called Asher inquiring about installing a new battery. He immediately offered to check mine for free. Once he realized that it was indeed ready to be changed, he moved quickly. He was transparent about pricing and did not have me waiting long. I would definitely come back again!

reviews.author: Barbara Levine
reviews.text: I met Asher, the owner of the shop who spent a lot of time with me showing what was wrong with my 2014 TSX Acura. Asher kept to schedule and repaired all of the necessary parts of the automobile so that I can continue to drive the car and feel safe!!

reviews.author: Bill Tobin
reviews.text: Asher is a great person and mechanic. Fixed a bunch of problems on our Jeep and in a timely fashion!! Will be bringing our other car for him to service for sure. A+++

reviews.text: I had a car sitting in my driveway for 2 years that I desperately needed to get on the road again. Asher was patient and kind in getting my car back on the road, and saved me a lot of money in the process. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Andrew Scallo
reviews.text: Asher helped me out with getting my car fixed. When I brought it in after looking at Ashur told me what was wrong and explained why it was wrong and how that could affect the car. He was clear and answered all my questions. My car was not blowing air into the cabin, that's what I brought it in for and when I got it back, it was working great!

reviews.author: adam weinstock
reviews.text: Had issue with the ignition coil and injector and fixed issue in a timely manor at a reasonable rate. Great work.

reviews.author: Braiau Gonzalez Sanchez
reviews.text: I had issue with the throttle body and they take care with the problem they also gave me a discount I recommend everybody the price is very reasonable!

reviews.author: Meghan Pfeiffer
reviews.text: I would HIGHLY recommend this auto shop to everyone I know! Not only is he more then reasonably priced he works with you as well. He's very honest as well. As a woman who has gotten scammed by this industry before who "recommends" unnecessary things and makes you pay out the butt for cost of them. I have an older SUV (2004 jeep library) someone told me my SUV smelt like coolant and with it being an older vehicle I got concered and wanted to get it checked out ASAP. So I came in here with a possible coolant leak, and to get my heat looked at. I also came in here to get a quote to get my gas gage fixed and my rear differential. He said he'd look at everything. He straight up told me to not waste the money on getting the gas gage fixed bc of how old the car was and it wasnt worth putting that much money into an older car. He recommend a flush to look for leaks and to get my heat fixed first, instead of instantly going to the more expensive route. He then went to check on the rear differential and noticed i had no brakes and the rotors were bad as well! Worst part was there were no signs of my brakes being bad. He fixed everything in a timely manner! I was only here for 2-3 hours for him to look at, diagnose, fix and test everything. I will be coming back for any future problems! Nice, trustworthy, & reasonably priced for a mechanic. You dont find those too often!

reviews.author: Lakeisha Cheatum
reviews.text: Had my altinator fixed here. Asher the owner was very nice and affordable! I highly recommend you bring your car to be fixed at his shop!! Very fast work also car was done in 2 hours

reviews.author: Ruthie Whitley
reviews.text: I’m thankful I came to fix the breaks an it’s was a very reasonable pricing customer service was amazing very home like feels when coming to get my car fixed excellent work.

reviews.author: Shari Zolla
reviews.text: This mechanic saved us in a pinch! Asher was incredible! We came to him with an old vehicle that needed to pass inspection, but had a warning light that wouldn't turn off. Asher took us on immediately, and the very next day the car was passed. He did some spectacular troubleshooting and used creative problem solving to address the issue and make sure that the car was safely functioning, while he did his best to keep the cost down to a minimum. On a personal note, Asher was very sensitive to the fact that my aging father, who drives this car, required a little extra attention. I feel good knowing that a reliable and trustworthy mechanic is in close proximity to where Dad lives, so I feel confident that if future issues arise, Asher will take care of my Dad's needs.

reviews.author: kelvin garcia
reviews.text: I was recommend Asher by another mechanic. Not only was he professional, but very accommodating and informative. Asher gave me a great deal. It was the best $1700 investmenton my car i could have made. Its hard to find a honest and trustworthy mechanic, and he is that. I will always bring my vehicles to him. Top tear work and person.

reviews.author: T Hashim
reviews.text: I was extremely disappointed when I discovered the low level of character and professionalism this business, especially the owner, operates with. My family went in for an oil change and the entire experience was full of disrespect and confusion. We called twice before arriving, and I personally heard my cousin apologize for running late and ask if coming at that moment was still okay. The owner clearly said yes and that he would be waiting. But when we showed up, his whole attitude changed. He immediately said our car was “too big,” that it was “falling apart,” and that he didn’t want to work on it. If you claim to be an auto shop and we’re willing to pay, why refuse the service you agreed to? We reminded him that we had confirmed with him earlier twice and that he said he would take the car for an oil change. He then said he didn’t want to work on a car that size and that it “already had oil in it.” Since when is a car supposed to be completely low or empty before getting an oil change? I was shocked, especially after seeing good reviews that made me feel confident about choosing this place. Unfortunately, I was wrong. This business showed a serious lack of character, consistency, and professionalism for a job they chose to do. I would not recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Sir RA
reviews.text: Going to AA Affordable Auto Repair, Towing, and Locksmith was the worst experience I’ve ever had with any auto shop in my life. I called them twice before arriving, explained my situation, and we agreed they would take a look at my car and do an oil change. But when I showed up, they suddenly refused to work on my car. The owner was extremely rude. He told me my car was “too big” and questioned why he should even work on it since it “still had oil in it.” Why would anyone wait until their car is completely dry before getting an oil change? That made no sense to me. I tried to explain that I genuinely needed help and just wanted him to look at it. He still said no and then told me that if he even looked at my car, it would be $50, and he wasn’t changing the oil. I left completely confused and disappointed because we had already agreed over the phone that they would help. If you value your time, respect, and good energy, do not go here.

reviews.author: Anil kumar
reviews.text: I went to AA Auto repair to get my Nissan Altima breaks done. My experience with Asher was great, he is very genuine and reasonable with repair charges. He replaced both front and rear wheels pads and rotors and also done some repair without replacing the parts to save some money and still do a good job. I would recommend him. Moreover, while I had to leave my car for repair he arranged a ride back home for me, which was nice,

reviews.author: Georgieana Mousa
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Asha! From the moment I walked in, I was treated with professionalism and honesty. They took the time to explain what was going on with my car in a way I could easily understand and gave me clear options before starting any work. The repairs were done quickly, the price was fair, and my car now runs better than ever. What stood out most was the level of care, they really went above and beyond to make sure I felt confident and safe driving away. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy, skilled, and reliable mechanic!

reviews.text: I needed to have work done on my friend's CR-V and Asher was able to do all of the work and then some. He not only did all of what I requested with the components I wanted but didn't charge for some extras such as additional rustproofing and changing the oil. His prices and timely service were very competitive and above board; I wish I could give more than 5 stars. I very much recommend checking him out if you need service. Thank you again, Asher.

reviews.author: Caroline Brown
reviews.text: Terrific service. Got a flat tire on the ramp and Asher fixed it immediately ...got me running again. Thanks

reviews.author: Olga Pachi
reviews.text: Mr. Asher is an honest, knowledgeable and amazing Mechanic. I recently moved to NJ and needed to get my 2005 Ford vehicle ready for an inspection, to include addressing some required repairs to ensure I had a safe and reliable vehicle. I initially took my vehicle to the dealership to get an estimate for the repairs I knew it required. I was quoted for repairs my vehicle needed, to include repairs that were not even of concern and/or an issue, i.e. - replacement of all spark plugs, all ignition coils and the catalytic converter. This prompted me to conduct my own search for a Mechanic that could honestly tell me what indeed was wrong with my car and if the additional “found” issues were legitimate. Mr. Asher thoroughly examined my vehicle determining it only needed to have the catalytic converter flushed, to include the replacement of only one spark plug and one ignition coil. Hence, Mr. Asher saved me $3000 dollars, ensured my vehicle passed inspection without issue and returned to me a sound/reliable vehicle. Mr. Asher is now officially my “go to” Mechanic in NJ. THANK YOU MR. ASHER!!

reviews.author: CLAUDIO MOREL
reviews.text: Asher is amazing super Accommodating help me out when nobody could fix major repair on my BMW and also was able to replace the engine on my 2018 jeep patriot. Asher Let me keep my vehicle on the premises until we were able to sort out all the issues with the vehicle and was able to work with me on a biweekly basis for payments. No issues whatsoever. Highly recommended for anyone that needs any big car repairs. No job is too big or too small for this place

reviews.author: Will Kokinakos
reviews.text: Asher is a great guy and trustworthy mechanic. He has, on multiple occasions, gone above and beyond to help get my car fixed quickly and satisfactorily. I come here whenever I have an issue -- he's the most accommodating and skilled mechanic in the area.

reviews.author: William W.
reviews.text: Ashel is an excellent, trustworthy mechanic. His prices are fair and he does good work. It’s a challenge to find a mechanic you feel comfortable with, and I would highly recommend Ashel to anyone looking for a good mechanic.

reviews.author: Taylor Beverly
reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE! I shouldn’t have listened to the good reviews. This man is shady and charged over $300 for labor and held my car for 4 days like someone else said in the reviews. He told me to bring it in on a Sunday night and he would inspect and fix my brakes asap the next day. Then called saying there was more damage and he couldn’t fix it at all. THEN suddenly on Thursday he says it’s fixed and charged me $600 total with extra work done I didn’t ask for and proceeds to tell me he won’t release my keys without immediate payment. I paid half the price for my brakes in north jersey, there was no logical reason for his pricing. Do not trust this man or his services. He is unprofessional and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Simone Johnson
reviews.text: I found Asher when I called as a last effort to find someone with reasonable pricing. Other local businesses wanted to charge too much for my transmission. Asher was patient and did his best to ensure I was a satisfied customer. He’s incredibly knowledgeable, personable and willing and able to explain the car’s diagnosis and what he thinks the remedy is. He even drove me home instead of having to call an Uber. It was a slow day so don’t expect that lol. Today, Asher was very busy and he made sure my other car was completed in the time he promised. Most importantly, Asher will try hi VERY BEST to transfer savings onto the customer. He described to me how he was super patient with something on my car that was giving him trouble, because otherwise a replacement part would be costly. He took the extra time to repair instead of spending unnecessarily money on a replacement. My daughter’s car needed brakes and tires as it sat too long at home while she was at college. He said no, she shouldn’t drive it like this. I can’t let you do that. It was that extra care that reminded me that he truly treats his customers as family. Thanks so much Asher!

reviews.author: Isabelle Cox
reviews.text: Needed a headlight changed, owner was able to get me in right away and fixed within the hour at a great price! Asher was extremely friendly and communicative on what was damaged and what was necessary for me to repair. Never tried to upsell me on anything, very honest guy. Will definitely be going back here for services.

reviews.author: Orr Levy
reviews.text: I had great experience with Asher. My GMC had a cluster problem, my monitors stopped working. After visiting several mechanics, Asher was the most decent and most professional, solving the problem quickly and efficiently with minimal cost. I strongly recommend AA repair !

reviews.author: John Larson
reviews.text: Can't believe that I have lived ~2 miles from this shop and did not know about them earlier. It would've saved me many reluctant trips to the dealer for service. They got me in next day for urgent spark plug replacement on 2018 Toyota Highlander. I ended-up having mechanic perform complete 100K mileage service. Fantastic experience!

reviews.author: Brian Gray
reviews.text: Have been bringing our cars to Asher for many years and he has always done quality work at very good prices. Would recommend AA Auto repair for all your car services. Work is always done quickly and properly.

reviews.author: Shea Thomas
reviews.text: Asher was extremely helpful and very honest, he charged me a decent price and explained in detail all the problems with my car. There was no wait and it didn’t take long for my car to get fixed.

reviews.author: Cady Greenberg
reviews.text: Came in with a major AC issue on the hottest day of the Summer. Within an hour it was taken care of.

reviews.author: Akhtar Husain
reviews.text: Awesome service experience. Ashar was very helpful and provided his guidance on work to be done to my Honda Civic work done as below Brake repair Electric coil repair

reviews.author: Marilyn wagner
reviews.text: Best Auto Repair shop in the entire Freehold Area. This Repair shop is 100% reliable and the most professional, hands down. I had recently gotten a flat tire while driving thru the freehold area, I called AA Auto and Asher was an absolute savior to my car troubles. He assisted in directing me to the shop safely and assured me he could help. He was very knowledgeable of Auto services and explained everything to me and assisted me on deciding on what I'd like him to do on my vehicle first. It was comforting to have someone go through everything with me and discuss options and prices. He is a true professional. And the work he did on my vehicle was great, 5 stars all around for everything. I'd highly recommend Asher and AA Auto Repair on Schank rd in Freehold to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Ben Dasher
reviews.text: I needed a mechanic to look at a used truck I was buying. The dealership was in Jersey and I didn't know any mechanics in Jersey. Luckily for me not far from the dealership was this random little garage with a million Stellar reviews from Google. So I called them up and spoke with Asher who said I could bring the truck in so he could take a careful look. And that he did. When I brought the truck to him at noon he was as friendly as he was efficient. It was clear to me I was dealing with an honest mechanic with tons of experience who would give me a qualified opinion. in about 30 minutes he drove the truck around, put it on the lift' checked every inch of it, ran computer Diagnostics, and pointed out everything he liked about it or thought were points of concern as well as all the things he thought I should do to it to keep it running strong well into the future. With his recommendation I felt confident purchasing the truck and probably brought home my new baby. I'm grateful to Asher at AA affordable auto repair for bringing his vast experience to helping me with my vehicle. And he's a nice guy like a really nice guy

reviews.author: Jamie Claar
reviews.text: Absolutely The worst experience ever! I live in another state and was visiting New Jersey. When I arrived at my location my car completely shut off and I had to get it towed. Working through my insurance I towed it to this location. It was on a Sunday so I had to stay overnight in New Jersey and was not able to speak to the repair shop until the following day. I went by the repair shop and spoke to the owner regarding my vehicle. I asked him if it needed a new engine if he was able to do the work and he told me yes. He had me give a deposit 600 + to "look at my car" and told me he would contact me in a few days. When I spoke with him later that week he told me he was unable to locate an engine and that the engines were back ordered through the dealership. He also told me that it would take him several months to install a new engine. I told him that was fine and I made arrangements to get another vehicle. Then he told me that he would be going on vacation and would be gone for the next 3 weeks. I waited for the 3 weeks to go by doing research of my own. Working with a local mechanic shop. I was able to locate a used engine that would be compatible with my car. When the owner returned from vacation this past Monday, he contacted me and told me that he would not be doing the work and that I would need to make arrangements to have my vehicle moved from his location. I asked about the money that I had given him and he told me" it was to look at my car " and told me that he had been trying to work with me by not charging me storage fees. How could you charge someone storage fees when you've been on vacation for the past 3 weeks? He told me if I did not get my vehicle moved he would start charging storage fees which would be on top of the $600+ he already had. I had my car towed to another repair shop on Wednesday I followed up with them today and they have already found an engine for my car and we have arrangements for it to be installed. This place is a total scam and would not use it at all.

reviews.author: Khedive McIntosh
reviews.text: Excellent service! I got seen right away. The initial check was free and he was able to change my alternator on my old BMW at a really affordable rate same day!. Definitely would recommend!

reviews.author: Samantha De La Riva
reviews.text: Asher has been extremely helpful. I purchased a used car (yr. 2000) because I needed something to get me around and he has been great at making sure it's safe to drive me and my daughter around. The car needed initial repairs to the subframe and he was very helpful in identifying immediate repairs needed for safety vs. repairs I'd have to do later down the road for maintenance. Obviously, with an older car the upkeep could be endless, so I'm grateful that Asher is transparent with me instead of trying to keep racking up the bill. Additionally, he goes above and beyond and drops me off/picks me up whenever my car needs service. I recently had an issue with my brake lines, and I called him that night and he was able to get it repaired ASAP. I always feel like I'm getting a fair price and a straight forward diagnoses

Made a phone call and Asher told me to calm down everything would be okay. He had a tow truck to my location with 20 minutes and how grateful I was for that. Even the tow truck driver was kind and understanding and said I was lucky it could have been much worse but you are safe now so let’s focus on getting you car to shop so AA could fix it and make it safe for you to drive. Got to the shop and with no way home Asher said I will bring you home which not all repair shops offer that type of excellent service. On the ride home he said I am going to do everything I can to keep the cost down and provide you a safe SUV to drive. Asher kept in touch with regular updates. He replace my wheel, did my brakes, filled my fluids and some other repairs tro make it safe. He kept my cost down and service at an ultimate high. not only did he fix my car he did it in record time. I can not thank AA enough for making not only my feel better but also for the excellent service to my car. I highly recommend anyone giving him their business. Thank you AA for caring about your community and their safety on their vehicles. You have a repeat customer from here on out.

reviews.text: He was ok. Did the work the first time I went to him. The second time I went to him was because my left headlight died. reviews.author: Ryan Szabo
reviews.text: Brought my 2017 Jeep Cherokee into this shop due to an oil filter housing crack and some other minor repairs in December of 2022. The service was performed quickly, but at a hefty cost. Due to the circumstances, the price of the repair did not bother me. Upon inspection of my vehicle afterwards, I did notice that components were not put back correctly and there was damage to 2 brackets in front of the engine. 8 Months later, my car experienced the same complete oil leak. I brought it in to another shop in Maryland only to be told that the original rework to my oil filter housing was not done correctly. It was missing crucial hardware needed for the housing, which caused it to crack once again. The repair work for this was a much lower cost than what initially paid AA Affordable. Though in a pinch, this company was very helpful and willing to take my vehicle in and return to me quickly. And I'm sure this instance is not a reflection of the quality of their work based on other reviews, but if I would've known that I would be experiencing the same problem again, I would've taken it somewhere else.

I don't even live in Freehold anymore but I still get my repairs at AAA Auto because it's worth the drive just to know that I will not be taken advantage of. reviews.text: I was having a problem with my power steering, the team here diagnosed it correctly and fixed it within a few hours. They were upfront about the costs and didn't overcharge. Really appreciate their honesty.

reviews.author: Rafael Cuevas
reviews.text: I had an exhaust leak preventing me from passing inspections, I brought my c ar here and got it passed a day later. Best part is I didn’t need to buy an entirley new catalytic converter, they were able to repair the pipe with a sleeve, would recommend this place to everyone.

reviews.author: Hemant Aneja
reviews.text: Asher is the best mechanic in Monmouth county! Reliable, trustworthy and friendly - I highly recommend him! I've been to many other mechanics in the past and no one has been better than him!

reviews.author: Lance
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Asher at AA affordable auto repair for years, and everytime I have left with a smile on my face. He has always went above and beyond for me, as well as blowing the competitors prices out of the water. Will continue giving him all my family business.

reviews.author: danielle bruno
reviews.text: I went to the car dealership and they told me I need a completely different tire for $180. So ridiculous I went to Asher and he told me that they were wrong and I didn’t even need a new one! He fixed it right up no problem for only $20, the absolute best place best service! I will continue to always come here before anywhere else!

reviews.author: adam lifson
reviews.text: I was recommended Asha from a relative. He is provided me with many updates while my car was beginning worked on as well as pricing. His prices arw very fair and his work is outstanding.He is a very knowledgeable mechanic and my car is is driving great.

reviews.author: Tobi Kirsch
reviews.text: Whenever I need an emergency repair, Asher always fits me into his busy schedule . If I do not have time to wait, he even gives me a ride home. He stands behind his work and always gives an affordable price. The shop is conveniently located near Route 9 in Freehold.

reviews.author: Ryan H
reviews.text: Scammer charged me twice as much for the tow than was quoted then repaired my vehicle with a used and broken part. He then try to extort me for $200 for a inspection sticker because of the failed repair. The part they installed is still broken and under warranty and they refuse to fix. Garbage place with a scamming owner.

reviews.author: Padam Thapa
reviews.text: I was stuck on route 9 in the middle of the night and called asher. A tow truck came quickly and even jumped my car for free. I brought the car to asher and he did a free diagnostic and told me I only had to replace a wire. I highly recommend him hes honest and ectremely reasonable.

reviews.author: Nicholas Vittoria
reviews.text: Was in a very big bind, found AA auto repair here on 60 Shack ave in Freehold, spoke with Asher he new what I needed and was incredibly helpful,and did a great job on my car. I recommend him very highly.

reviews.author: Marquis Freeman
reviews.text: Had a last minute repair needed this morning so I called and without hesitation they were able to see me immediately and fixed the issue with speed and precision. Highly recommend and will now be going to them for all my repairs and maintenance needs !

reviews.author: Karl Madl
reviews.text: Asher is the absolute homie. Most honest mechanic of all time ever. He'll straight up tell you "yeah this needs to be fixed but not right now just come back in a few months." Hella personable and nice. Prices are reasonable and fair. 12/10 would go again and again

reviews.author: John Toigo
reviews.text: Total rip off. $88 for 8 spark plugs? Overcharged for all the parts & labor. My fault - broke down right by his shop. Told me one price & then charged twice that on the final bill. Should have gotten towed to my mechanic.

reviews.author: Laura Yac
reviews.text: Always have a good experience when I bring my vehicle here. He doesn't try to "up sell" anything for the sake of getting more money from you. He gets you up and running at a reasonable price. Quickly. Great service

reviews.author: Ram Samptur
reviews.text: AAA Auto is the most reliable place in town to get your car fixed . I have known the proprietor Asher Cohen for 6 years, he is a trustworthy and caring person . He was a helicopter mechanic in Israel, so it goes without saying, that he knows what he is doing .

reviews.author: Renee Geller
reviews.text: I have gone to AAA a few times recently for emergencies and the service is excellent, fair prices, professional and honest. This place is the best you can find for auto repairs! I will always go there from now on. Hard to find places like this anymore.

reviews.author: Rene Alvarez
reviews.text: AA Affordable Auto Repair really came through for me when my car broke down. Their towing service was prompt and their mechanics fixed the issue in record time. Thanks for getting me back on the road!

reviews.author: Frances Dotson
reviews.text: I was impressed by their efficient service when I needed a brake pad replacement. They were professional, quick and didn’t try to sell me anything I didn't need. Highly recommend them for any auto repair needs.

reviews.author: Philip Kossoy
reviews.text: Asher from AAA automotive is the best. His prices are reasonable and his repairs are done right! I highly recommend him if you are in search for a new mechanic.

reviews.author: Annie Rammie
reviews.text: I had a pleasant experience with Asher, this is my second time going to him and everytime I know I'm in good hands. He is trust worthy and def. Knows what he's doing. It doesn't hurt that he's funny as well ! Def recommend this spot

reviews.author: Latonya Drew
reviews.text: My car's AC had been acting up for a while, AA Affordable Auto Repair diagnosed the problem quickly and recharged my AC, making my summer drives enjoyable again. Top-notch service!

reviews.author: Ben S
reviews.text: We were stuck after breaking down on the road, from upstate NY. Asher helped us out greatly by getting us in within half hour. Fixed our issue while we had lunch nearby and got us back on the road in time for our dinner plans. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Damion Williams
reviews.text: I always come back to get my car fixed here. The do a lot of car repair​ and are very experienced. I strongly recommend you come here before going anywhere else. I just had my car towed here. Happy with the servic.

reviews.author: evan Meyerberg
reviews.text: This is a wonder repair shop. I did not know what was wrong with my car. I dropped it off and 10 minutes later they told me it was my transmission that cause my car to jolt. It was repaired very quickly. Also completed an oil change and replaced fluids. Very happy to switch mechanics. Will be back if I have more car issues.

reviews.author: Victor
reviews.text: Best Towing in Freehold NJ. I highly reccomended this place. He then fixed my brakes, came out perfectly. Doesn't play games, very honest guy. Would reccomended this to anyone.

reviews.author: M Lamonster
reviews.text: Great shop, always willing to help, very fair with their pricing. No job is ever done until the price and detail of the work is explained to you. I would definitely recommend AAA Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Eden Abrams
reviews.text: This is an excellent auto shop ! My truck is 13 years old and it works beautifully . I am so fortunate to have Asher work on my car. I always recommend this location to all friends.

reviews.author: Timothy Thomas
reviews.text: This is the most honest mechanic I've met in my life! Very hard working and makes sure to get the job done properly. He fixed what Honda couldn't at a cheaper cost!

reviews.author: For Music
reviews.text: Asher is the only mechanic I would trust my car with . He’s honest and treats all his customers like family .

reviews.author: Ben Tirabassi
reviews.text: They were very attentive to my needs when I couldn’t pass inspection. They worked on preparing my car to pass in a fast and efficient manner. Best mechanic in town for sure.

reviews.author: Joseph Bonifaz
reviews.text: Fantastic work. Was able to squeeze me in within 24 hours and spent the time to walk me through what was going to be done. Absolutely happy with the results of the bumper fix.

reviews.author: Sudip Baniya
reviews.text: Best mechanic in freehold ..I bought my car in AaAuto repair they tuned up my ca,replace the tires and put the new brakes ..the price was excellent highly Recommended

reviews.author: Jason Sales
reviews.text: Car wouldn't start on a Friday night. Asher took it in on Monday morning and had me out of there in a few hours, back on the road again. Wonderful service and customer service.

reviews.author: long nguyen
reviews.text: first time at this place and the mechanic was very friendly and super helpful. They do a great job with my car and would highly rexommend anyone to get thier maintenance done here.

reviews.author: Jesse Schuh
reviews.text: Had an emergency with my car in Marlboro, and this auto repair service was a lifesaver. Quick diagnosis, effective solution, and friendly staff.

reviews.author: len sorokin
reviews.text: Great shop. Highly recommend and trust for any repairs. Just there for brakes and suspension was fast and quality work, better pricing than dealers and national chains

reviews.author: Eduardo deFreitas
reviews.text: Great service, I just had a great experience at AA affordable auto repair. I had very quick service and affordable prices. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kunal Madan
reviews.text: I always come to this place to get my car fixed. My car is always fixed at a fair price. I'd recommend coming here before you go anywhere else. Don't go to the dearship, they rip you off.

reviews.author: Zach Furman
reviews.text: Service was fast, Asher cared about getting the car working properly. Highly recomend to anyone around monmouth county
